title: Hell Naw Dog
blurb: Refusal, plus a follow-up question about how the request was ever spoken aloud. This is no polite decline with a reason attached. It is a full-body rejection of a proposal that had no chance from the moment it was conceived, and the delivery makes clear that the asking itself was the offence. Deploy it against terrible plans, cursed food combinations, and quick favours that are demonstrably neither quick nor favours. The definitive no for situations well beyond the reach of ordinary manners.
